description: This file defines the main React application component, setting up routing and access control for different pages based on user roles in a digital health certificate issuance system.

classes.name: ProtectedRoute
classes.description: A wrapper component that enforces role-based access control for its child components, redirecting unauthorized users.

methods.name: ProtectedRoute
methods.description: Function component that checks if the user has the correct role before rendering children or redirecting.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main application component that sets up routing for the web interface, utilizing ProtectedRoute for role-restricted pages.
